components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a screen or card.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px var(--accent-glow); transition: transform 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px var(--accent-glow); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; transition: background 200ms ease-out, border-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-button-outline:hover { border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--surface); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Question Card
components.description: Identity, editorial question, answer, and compact actions.
components.html:
MONA · JUL 27

What changed your mind?

A considered answer with room to breathe.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 16px 0; color: var(--primary); font-family: "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.75; } .ds-card-meta { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--foreground); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field textarea { min-height: 96px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font: inherit; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-field textarea:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-field textarea:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Floating Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 15%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px; background: var(--card); box-shadow: var(--shadow-navbar); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 35%, transparent); } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); }

narrative.overview: Askora is a considered publication that happens to be interactive: private-by-default, identity-aware, and unmistakably editorial purple on paper.
keyCharacteristics: Compact familiar hierarchy without borrowed branding

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Editorial Purple is the only everyday accent.

rules.name: The Question Voice Rule
rules.body: Questions use the serif voice; answers use the sans body face.

rules.name: The Border-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Borders establish surfaces before ambient shadow.

dos: Do preserve identity, content, then actions.
Do keep anonymous sender data absent.
donts: Don't make Askora a direct copy of Facebook.
Don't introduce generic SaaS chrome or engagement pressure.
